# RioCharts

> Charts for Blazor in pure .NET (line, area, bar, scatter, pie, donut, radial bar, radar, heatmap, box plot, candlestick, treemap), with server-side PNG/SVG export and JSON chart specs for AI agents. Preview packages for .NET 10.

Setup: `dotnet add package RioCharts.Blazor --prerelease`, then `@using RioCharts.Blazor` and `@using RioCharts.Core` in `_Imports.razor`. Nothing to register. A chart:

```razor
<RioChart Items="orders">
    <BarSeries XValue="o => o.Country" YValue="o => (double)o.Value" Aggregate="Aggregate.Sum" />
</RioChart>
```

Tooltips, zoom and clicks need an interactive render mode. Set `TItem` on `<RioChart>` when it has event handlers.

## Guide for coding agents

- [llms-full.txt](https://joadan.github.io/RioCharts/llms-full.txt): setup, rules, compiled examples and every component parameter in one file. Read this before writing RioCharts code.

## Beyond Blazor

- [JSON specs](https://joadan.github.io/RioCharts/specs): the chart model as JSON, with a playground
- [Server-side export](https://joadan.github.io/RioCharts/server-export): PNG and SVG with RioCharts.Skia
- [AI agents and MCP](https://joadan.github.io/RioCharts/ai): create_chart for agents in your app, and `riocharts-mcp`, a local MCP server that renders charts and turns specs into Razor
